description:
OUT NOW! 

Introducing Curyman II, the highly anticipated album out via Diamond West Records on November 22. Featuring collaborations with renowned musicians and a production that honors the roots of Brazilian music while pushing its boundaries, expect an album that is both a celebration and an evolution of Rogê's signature style. Curyman II is not just an album; it’s an invitation to immerse yourself in the soul-stirring world of Rogê once again.
